summary:
## Getting Started with Canva

Use Canva to create a professional personal portfolio for free. Start by navigating to the **Templates** section and searching for the keyword **"portfolio"** to find a design that fits your needs.

> [!TIP]
> A Canva Pro free trial can give you access to a wider variety of premium templates and design elements to make your portfolio stand out.

## Customizing Your Portfolio

Once you select a template, you can customize every aspect of it.

*   **Edit Content**: Double-click any text box to replace placeholder text with your own name, details, and project descriptions.
*   **Change Colors**: Click on any colored shape or background to open the color picker. You can choose a new color or input a specific hex code to match your personal brand. Canva saves your recently used colors for easy access across pages.
*   **Manage Elements**: Delete any placeholder graphics you don't like. Use the **Elements** tab to search for new icons, photos, or shapes and drag them onto your design. To find similar graphics, click an element, select the three-dots menu, and choose **"See more like this."**

> [!NOTE]
> You can manage the layering of elements by right-clicking on an object and selecting options like "Send to back" or "Bring to front" to arrange them correctly.

## Building Your Portfolio Content

- **Add New Pages**: Click **"Add a page"** to expand your portfolio. You can apply a new template to the new page or duplicate an existing page to maintain a consistent style.
- **Showcase Your Best Work**: The goal of the portfolio is to feature your strongest projects. Compile your best work (images, case study descriptions) and add them to your portfolio pages. You can upload your own assets by dragging and dropping them from your computer directly into the Canva editor.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Quality over quantity. Only include your best and most relevant work. If you're a graphic designer, this might be your top logos, flyers, or social media campaigns.

## Finalizing and Exporting

When your portfolio is complete, it's time to export it for sharing.

1.  Click the **Share** button in the top-right corner.
2.  Select **Download** from the dropdown menu.
3.  Under **File type**, choose **PDF Standard**. This format is ideal for emailing to potential employers or clients.
4.  Ensure you've selected to download **All pages**.
5.  Click **Download** to save the final PDF to your computer.
